definitions.explanation: A note added to explain or comment on something in a text. Often seen in academic writing, textbooks, and translations.
When used in compounds, can mean attention or care, as in {注意|ちゅうい} (attention/caution).

examples.japanese: この{本|ほん}には{詳|くわ}しい{注|ちゅう}がついている。
{難|むずか}しい{言葉|ことば}には{注|ちゅう}をつけてください。
examples.english: Please add notes to difficult words.
examples.notes: 注をつける = to add annotations

examples.japanese: {脚注|きゃくちゅう}を{参照|さんしょう}してください。

notes:
USAGE: {注|ちゅう} as a standalone word is somewhat formal and typically appears in written/academic contexts. More commonly appears in compounds.

COMMON COMPOUNDS:
・{注意|ちゅうい} (attention, caution)
・{注目|ちゅうもく} (attention, notice)
・{注文|ちゅうもん} (order, request)
・{脚注|きゃくちゅう} (footnote)
・{注釈|ちゅうしゃく} (annotation, commentary)
・{注記|ちゅうき} (note, annotation)

PATTERNS:
・{注|ちゅう}をつける (to add notes)
・{注|ちゅう}を{入|い}れる (to insert annotations)
・{注|ちゅう}を{参照|さんしょう}する (to refer to notes)
